Administrative Reshuffle: IAS and HCS Officers Transferred in Haryana and UP

In Haryana, an administrative reshuffle saw 5 IAS and 3 HCS officers transferred, with several given additional responsibilities. Maniram Sharma was appointed MD of the Electricity Corporation. Separately, in Uttar Pradesh, the police department conducted a significant reshuffling, transferring 18 IPS officers to new roles. This follows a previous transfer of 35 IPS officers in the state. The Yogi government also made a large-scale administrative change, moving 34 IAS officers and altering District Magistrates in several districts.
